_meta.title: SentinelOne
_meta.setup: Console → Settings → Users → create a service user with role “Viewer” → generate an API token (it expires, note the date). Put the tenant URL into base_url.

description: SentinelOne – agents, threats, alerts, sites (read only recommended)
notes: Read only. Never trigger actions (isolate, uninstall, mitigation, exclusions) unless explicitly asked.
API tokens expire – renew the token on 401.
